chapter: Kansas City, Omaha and Lloyd Hunter
title: Strategy of battling bands
summary: Bands laid in wait, making the other play first and then topping it, and dancers could not be fooled.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Well, that's good. Well, that was a very good band. Was that your first experience of a battle between two bands?
Because those bands that used to battle a lot, they had worked out a whole strategy.
Don't come up with your numbers. Make the other guy come up with his numbers first and then top him.
That was it. That's the way we did it.
Yeah, yeah. Lay in wait for them.
We'd Lay in wait for them.
We played one set, they come and play another set.
Then they'd come back and play a set and they'd play the other set.
Yeah, it's fun, because those dancers know.
No, they knew what was happening.
